name: hcl
description: Instantiate a Terraform/OpenTofu module as a Pulumi component.

hcl:index:Module.description: A Terraform/OpenTofu module instantiated as a component resource.

inputs.description: The module's input variables, keyed by variable name.

outputs.description: The module's output values, keyed by output name.

source.description: The module source address (a registry reference, URL, or local path).

version.description: An optional version constraint, used when source is a registry module reference.
